summary: The source forms CSR with n terminal entries; groupSize is selected from average row length, with 128/256-thread long-row kernels at the corresponding thresholds and otherwise widths 1–32. The short-row kernel grid-strides rows and each subgroup processes the full row interval in width strides; long-row variants assign block rows in grid-stride order and process full intervals, then reduce/store. Warmup is outside timing; when iterations>1, a graph contains batch=min(iterations,128) complete launches and an optional tail graph contains iterations%batch launches. Timed execution loops over iterations/batch graph replays and launches the tail remainder; the no-graph case launches the requested sole iteration. Main forwards the parsed iteration count; compiled host lambda and spmvGpu body, launch targets and all eight native sm86 variants were inspected.
